ctgov.note: All Catalyst-sponsored ctgov entries are completed or terminated.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Catalyst Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage rare-neurology specialty pharma. Its three marketed brands (FIRDAPSE, AGAMREE, FYCOMPA) are all FDA-approved; per FY2025 10-K, no company-sponsored Phase 1/2/3 clinical trials are active. The 10-K describes only commercial operations and an active business-development / acquisition strategy, with no internal investigational pipeline. Investigator-sponsored studies of FIRDAPSE in additional indications previously listed on ctgov (SMA Type 3, MuSK-MG) were terminated.

marketed: AGAMREE (vamorolone) — Duchenne muscular dystrophy (US license from Santhera)
FYCOMPA (perampanel) — partial-onset and primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures (Schedule III; LOE following May 2025 patent expiry)

excluded_legacy_terminated: Amifampridine in SMA Type 3 (Phase 2, NCT03819660) — terminated
CPP-115 (vigabatrin analog) cocaine dependency — Phase 1 completed, no advancement
CPP-109 (vigabatrin) addiction programs — terminated/completed without advancement
